properties.abstract: Not only is the Stockalperweg a popular route by foot, it’s quite the experience by bike too. There are thrilling trails to be had on both sides of the Simplon Pass, such as the snow shed over Simplonstrasse or the somewhat more technical trails in the woods.  PostBus is an easier option when it comes to covering most of the uphill altitude.
properties.description:
The Simplon high plateau is barren and rocky, with numerous glistening lakes between the imposing peaks. The tour sets off from the Simplon Hospiz stop. Following the Stockalperweg, it proceeds towards Simplon village, passing through Alpine pastures and past the old hospice (old hospital). This was built by the influential businessman from Brig, Kaspar Stockalper (1609–1691), after whom the bike route is named. The tower-like building was designed to protect traders with goods and beasts of burden. Stockalper and his family used the upper three storeys as a summerhouse. Head up to Engiloch mountain hut. A second passage then follows the drystone walls to the hamlet of Egga. At this point, the Stockalperweg descends into the woods and, after turning to the right, Simplon village will already be in sight.

Take the PostBus to the pass where more thrilling trails await: After the hospice, head up to Simplon Kulm where there is a place to rest and continue on to the Simplonstrasse snow shed. Follow the trail to Schalbett, where it descends into the woods over a metal ramp. Once you’re back on the road, you can take a break at Restaurant Ganterwald.

After a stretch of woodland, the Talweg Ganter valley trail will lead you under the Ganter Bridge. The trail runs under the pass road by the slope to Schallberg. Following the road for a short distance uphill, the trail then winds down through Chräjubielwald. Once you are back on the Stockalperweg, the last stretch ends a little further on in Brig. Cycling through the old town, you will pass by Stockalper Palace, the main landmark of this town in the Valais Alps.
properties.title: Stockalper Bike
